Coupons & delivery

Shared across all years. Enabled codes can be used in the cart. Uncheck Show on website to hide a code from public offers while keeping it usable by anyone you share it with. One percentage coupon per request; no code means no discount. Existing saved requests keep their original amounts.

Coupon codes

Delivery charges

Eligibility uses the items total after coupon discount, excluding delivery fees. At the minimum or above, delivery is free. Set the minimum or fee to 0 for free delivery on every request. Store pickup is always free.

Homepage video

Change the video on the public homepage. This setting is shared across all price-list years; prices, carts and order requests are unchanged.

Paste an HTTPS YouTube watch, Shorts or youtu.be link. Leave blank to hide the video. Only use videos you have permission to publish that allow embedding. Portrait Shorts work best; landscape videos keep YouTube's letterboxing.

View homepage (new tab)

Yearly price lists

Customers see one active year. Saving changes to the active list updates prices for new requests immediately. Existing orders keep their saved prices. Manage discounts separately in Coupons & delivery.

Select a product row to edit its details, effect types, visibility, photos and videos. Choose all applicable effects under Shop by type to help customers filter products. Uncheck Visible to customers when out of stock; recheck it when restocked. Files uploaded to Cloudinary are public; never include private information. Choose Save price list to publish changes. Effect types, visibility, photos and videos are independent for each year.

PDF includes the selected year's saved prices and excludes hidden products. Save changes before downloading. Coupons and delivery charges are not included.

Price-list products. Select a product to expand editing and media controls. Changes are saved together using Save price list.
